name: Vishnusurya Projects and Infra Ltd
business_description: Vishnusurya Projects and Infra Ltd executes turnkey contracts for large-scale infrastructure construction projects. The company generates revenue by designing, building, and delivering completed infrastructure assets to clients, typically under fixed-price or milestone-based contracts.
input_sensitivity: (1) Cost risks: Margins are sensitive to fluctuations in raw material prices (cement, steel, aggregates), labour costs, fuel and energy expenses, and interest rates impacting project financing. (2) Revenue/demand risks: Demand is directly driven by government and private sector capital expenditure on infrastructure development, especially in roads, bridges, and civil works.
output_note: Government agencies and private developers pay Vishnusurya Projects and Infra Ltd to construct and deliver completed infrastructure projects under turnkey contracts.
